question: Which of the following statements correctly defines the lyophilization process ?:

options.opa: It is a system of cold desiccation by means of a decrease of the pressure below the critical point of the water and subsequent sublimation.
options.opb: It is a system of desiccation by means of a decrease in pressure below the triple point of water and subsequent sublimation.
options.opc: It is a drying system by freezing the water contained in a sample and then raising the temperature to evaporate the ice formed.
options.opd: It is a drying system by freezing the water contained in a sample and subsequent sublimation of the ice formed.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: opc -> freezing water in a sample -> raising temperature to evaporate ice formed -> 70% CHAIN: opd -> freezing water in a sample -> subsequent sublimation of ice formed -> 80% CHAIN: opa -> cold desiccation -> decrease of pressure below critical point of water -> sublimation -> 75% CHAIN: opb -> desiccation -> decrease in pressure below triple point of water -> sublimation -> 70%
analysis: Lyophilization, also known as freeze-drying, is a drying process that involves freezing the water content in a sample and then sublimating the ice formed directly into vapor, bypassing the liquid phase. This method is commonly used in pharmacy to preserve sensitive drugs and biological materials.
